nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable contract, set to msg.sender in the constructor and zeroed in _init.
Boolean flag guarding contract initialization used by isInitialised modifier.
Boolean flag indicating deposits have been received; gates isDeposited and isNotDeposited modifiers.
Address authorized to call slash, set during _init.
Address of the proxy (auction contract) allowed to register depositors and deposit funds.
Timestamp after which withdrawals become possible; set from _releaseTimestamp in _init.
Mapping tracking which depositor addresses may still withdraw their deposit.
Counter of successfully registered depositors, incremented in registerDepositor.
Per-depositor deposit value stored during deposit.
ERC20 token interface stored by TokenDepositLocker.init.
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function updating the owner address from newOwner.
Restricted to depositorsProxy, marks a depositor as able to withdraw and increments the depositor count.
Payable function restricted to depositorsProxy computing depositAmount and calling the _receive hook.
Withdrawal function checking releaseTimestamp and canWithdraw[msg.sender], then calling _transfer.
Slashing function restricted to slasher that disables a depositor and calls _burn.
Internal initializer setting releaseTimestamp, slasher, depositorsProxy and zeroing owner.
Virtual hook implemented by TokenDepositLocker to pull ERC20 tokens via transferFrom.
Virtual hook implemented by TokenDepositLocker to send ERC20 tokens to a recipient.
Virtual hook implemented by TokenDepositLocker to burn ERC20 tokens.
onlyOwner external initializer that calls _init and stores the ERC20 token address.
Fallback function in BaseDepositLocker accepting empty calls/ETH.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization modifiers and withdrawals.
Block timestamp used for the release time gate and the _init future check.
External ERC20 transferFrom call performed inside _receive pulling tokens from msg.sender.
External ERC20 transfer call performed inside _transfer sending tokens to recipient.
External ERC20 burn call performed inside _burn.
Native ETH value transfer to msg.sender triggered during withdraw via the payable _transfer path.
Address parameter of registerDepositor marking the depositor to register.
Per-depositor value parameter of deposit used to compute depositAmount.
Local variable in deposit holding numberOfDepositors * _valuePerDepositor.
Address parameter of slash identifying the depositor to be slashed.
Timestamp parameter of _init assigned to releaseTimestamp.
Address parameter of _init assigned to slasher.
Address parameter of _init assigned to depositorsProxy.
IERC20 parameter of TokenDepositLocker.init stored into token.
Payable recipient parameter of _transfer forwarded to token.transfer.
Amount parameter of _transfer forwarded to token.transfer.
Amount parameter of _receive forwarded to token.transferFrom.
Amount parameter of _burn forwarded to token.burn.
Address parameter of transferOwnership written into owner.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership requires msg.sender == owner.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into the owner state variable.
onlyDepositorsProxy requires msg.sender == depositorsProxy in registerDepositor.
registerDepositor sets canWithdraw[_depositor] = true.
registerDepositor increments numberOfDepositors for the registered depositor.
deposit is gated by onlyDepositorsProxy checking msg.sender.
_valuePerDepositor is multiplied into the local depositAmount.
numberOfDepositors * _valuePerDepositor overflow-checked computation of depositAmount.
deposit stores _valuePerDepositor into valuePerDepositor.
deposit calls the _receive hook with depositAmount.
_receive performs an external token.transferFrom call pulling tokens from msg.sender.
withdraw requires canWithdraw[msg.sender] before transferring.
withdraw requires block.timestamp >= releaseTimestamp, introducing timestamp dependency.
withdraw calls the _transfer hook which performs an external token transfer after state update.
_transfer invokes the external token.transfer call.
withdraw path leads to native ETH transfer to msg.sender via payable _transfer, enabling re-entrancy.
slash requires msg.sender == slasher.
slash sets canWithdraw[_depositorToBeSlashed] = false.
slash calls the _burn hook performing an external token burn after state change.
_burn invokes the external token.burn call.
_init writes _releaseTimestamp into releaseTimestamp and validates it against block.timestamp.
_init writes _slasher into the slasher state variable.
_init writes _depositorsProxy into the depositorsProxy state variable.
TokenDepositLocker.init calls BaseDepositLocker._init.
init stores _token into the token state variable.
TokenDepositLocker.init is protected by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
recipient parameter of _transfer is forwarded to token.transfer.
amount parameter of _transfer is forwarded to token.transfer.
amount parameter of _receive is forwarded to token.transferFrom.
amount parameter of _burn is forwarded to token.burn.
_init requires _releaseTimestamp > block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
_receive pulls tokens from msg.sender via transferFrom, relying on caller identity.

normalization_plan.reason: The _depositor parameter of registerDepositor only mutates canWithdraw and the depositor counter, so it folds into the registerDepositor function node.
The _valuePerDepositor parameter of deposit feeds the depositAmount computation and valuePerDepositor write, so it folds into the deposit function node.
The local depositAmount in deposit is a derived intermediate value used solely inside deposit, so it folds into the deposit function node.
The _depositorToBeSlashed parameter of slash only feeds the canWithdraw flag update, so it folds into the slash function node.
The _releaseTimestamp parameter of _init is directly assigned to releaseTimestamp inside _init, so it folds into the _init function node.
The _slasher parameter of _init is directly assigned to the slasher state variable, so it folds into the _init function node.
The _depositorsProxy parameter of _init is directly assigned to the depositorsProxy state variable, so it folds into the _init function node.
The _token parameter of TokenDepositLocker.init is validated and stored into the token state variable, so it folds into init.
The recipient parameter of _transfer is forwarded to the external token.transfer call, so it folds into the _transfer hook node.
The amount parameter of _transfer is forwarded to the external token.transfer call, so it folds into the _transfer hook node.
The amount parameter of _receive is forwarded to token.transferFrom, so it folds into the _receive hook node.
The amount parameter of _burn is forwarded to token.burn, so it folds into the _burn hook node.
The newOwner parameter of transferOwnership is written directly into owner, so it folds into the transferOwnership function node.
